استقدروا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْدَرُوا (istaqdarū) /is.taq.da.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# اُسْتُقْدِرُوا (ustuqdirū) /us.tuq.di.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# اِسْتَقْدِرُوا (istaqdirū) /is.taq.di.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
